mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname} AND id <> #{id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, nickname, level, role, status) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{level}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = NOW(), email = CONCAT('withdrawn:', id), nickname = CONCAT('#탈퇴', id), bio = NULL, password_hash = '!WITHDRAWN' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
